value.rationale: Exactly three particles have no frozen full-sector configurations precisely for n=4..8. The complete finite classification identifies a genuine ring-size transition in integrated count noise: Poisson at n=4, super-Poisson monotonic at n=5, and a unique recovery-rate noise minimum at each n=6..8, despite strictly increasing mean hop throughput. This supplies a natural physically motivated constrained-transport noise benchmark distinct from the original Gibbs/mean-current law; no thermodynamic consequence or extrapolation is asserted.
